title: Planning to expand my tool. Need help :)
author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
selftext: Hi devs, I’ve made a game asset tool called PixelArtGen. Initially, the main goal was to generate game-ready 2D art assets, but I’ve been thinking it could go further...like creating AI text-to-3D assets or other types of game assets. My vision is to make a platform where developers don’t have to rely solely on finding the right assets, but can generate exactly what they need. (full respect to all the amazing artists out there), but I want to make this process easier and faster for devs. So, in your opinion, what kind of game assets do you mostly use? You can consider this a feature request since I’m planning to expand the tool, and I’d love to know what to prioritize next.

comments.author: Melodic-Damage3609
comments.body: I think the issue here is the huge server cost of running these open source tools, especially the latest image to 3D, right? So i think you should not be asking what we want, but what you can offer without going bankrupt.

replies.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
replies.body: Thanks for considering my opinion on what more I could bring to this plugin, but I’d really like to hear yours. If I can solve your problems, that would be great. My main goal with PixelArtGen is to make it a unified space for all kinds of game asset generation...like Cursor, but focused entirely on game assets. I know it’s a long shot and I might even fail, but I’m giving it my best shot. I also want to expand it broadly to include 3D assets, SFX generators, and more.

comments.author: mike402
comments.body: What are you bringing to the table that Ludo or meshy don’t do?

replies.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
replies.body: I could bring a game sfx generator but my ideal concept is kinda similar to ludo ( except for the analysis features ). So it's better to have various popular models used by multiple users in a single space
